answer: In a decentralized AI agent economy, cryptographic proofs of non-biological hardware rooted in a secure enclave can serve as a ferrous anchor against Sybil flooding. To successfully validate the decentralized atlas of network states, each autonomous node must commit scarce compute resources to solve continuous proof-of-work challenges. This economic burden ensures that malicious operators cannot harbor thousands of synthetic pseudonyms without incurring unsustainable capital and operational expenses, pricing out mass identity fabrication.
